full_report: At approximately 2:15 AM zone 5 river gauge exceeded critical threshold. Rainfall recorded at 95mm over 6 hours. Emergency dispatch received 42 calls from residents in low-lying blocks. Three roads including Main Bridge Road are now closed due to rising water. Ambulance unit 3 has been dispatched. Shelter capacity at Riverside Community Hall stands at 40 beds, currently 12 occupied. Team advises immediate evacuation of blocks A and B.

Zone 2 reported a structural wall collapse near the old warehouse district following sustained heavy rainfall. One injury confirmed, ambulance en route with estimated arrival in 8 minutes. Road closures affect two access points. No flooding reported in this zone yet. Monitoring team recommends continued surveillance for next 3 hours as rainfall is expected to continue.
